content:
6 worlds work together to save each other. J. Risk’s Realms Books span 6 different series with common characters and an ongoing, suspense-filled plot. Meet many powerful characters from other realms that will steal your heart and have you cheering for them. The Alterealm Series : Book 1 - The Huntress Book 2 - The Seer Book 3 - The Empath Book 4 - The Witch Book 5 - The Chronos Book 6- The Warrior Book 7- The Telepath Book 8- The Healer

Burn those who burned me is an anthology book circulated on truth; justice; and REVENGE! Story #1 The Ballad of Rabena Price. Story #2 The rebirth of Clara Gran
